name: Libby's Sweet Peas in Water (Tough Pea Skins WARNING)
whyItWorks: Whole canned green peas retain tough, fibrous outer skins and fermentable galacto-oligosaccharides (GOS). Whole pea skins resist digestion and accumulate in narrowed bowel segments.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid whole sweet peas during active disease. Canned green beans (Del Monte) are far gentler.
